One whole complete figure with transparent margins, square canvas, same crisp clean anime cel shading, truly transparent background. No text/watermark. Priority: visibly longer and more elegant legs without changing face or hand gesture.

refinementHistory.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset: a transparent rare character-scene illustration for the Umeko task-cover and desktop-pet idle.
Image 1 is the USER'S exact volume-8 novel illustration of Tiara Basori / 馬剃天愛星 and is authoritative for POSE, EXPRESSION, CLOTHING and emotional tone. Image 2 is only the app's approved colored chibi rendering style and identity palette.
Reinterpret image 1 faithfully as a polished small chibi vignette. Her head tilts gently, she looks softly towards viewer with heavily blushing cheeks, a small CLOSED-mouth shy smile and relaxed half-soft eyes. BOTH hands are held together at her upper abdomen/chest, fingers delicately interlaced/overlapping exactly as in image 1. Keep hands anatomically coherent. No hand reaching outward.
Identity: dark blue-black hair with the compact low bun, short divided fringe, distinctive short thick nearly straight eyebrows partly tucked beneath the fringe, gray-blue eyes.
Costume MUST follow image 1: WHITE COLLARED BLOUSE with rolled/shortened sleeves, stacked PALE BLUE bow ribbons, dark gray pleated skirt. NO blazer, jacket, clipboard, speech papers, snack or book.
Composition: one chibi character, 3-head-tall proportions; complete head, bun, elbows, hands, skirt and slim legs/shoes in frame. A very faint softly lit diagonal railing fragment behind her echoes the reference composition; do not replace with a campaign office or add story props. Airy gentle late-afternoon light and tiny drifting petals. The emotional focus is the shy, quiet smile rather than begging or a dramatic crying scene.
Crisp clean anime cel shading matching image 2, readable at 210px. Square canvas, transparent margins, TRUE alpha background outside the compact vignette. No text, speech bubbles, watermarks or additional people. The dialogue is rendered separately by the application.
